name: design-native-namespace
purpose: Observe a craft root on the native route (design-native-namespace-k200). The sandbox home adds the marketplace of the prepared Grove checkout at the removal commit and installs design@linkuistics from it, which declares grove as a dependency and adds ./craft/ to its skills. The Ravel settings have no skills key. The planted tree of design-craft-discovery holds one impl leaf that asks for a small command-line tool and names no skill. Expect the startup listing to name the four craft skills and the three kinds under design:, with no bare copy, and the Skill tool to load design:cli-tool-design before the tool is written.
